high_level_description: The image is a still from the animated TV show "The Simpsons." It features two characters, Marge Simpson and Homer Simpson, standing close to each other in what appears to be a backyard or garden area. Marge Simpson is on the left side of the image. She has her signature blue hair styled in a large, voluminous bob. She is wearing a green dress with a white collar and a red necklace. Her expression is one of concern or worry as she looks at Homer. Homer Simpson is on the right side of the image. He has his characteristic yellow skin and spiky hair
